craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Wholly-taken rest; skull-staff-pretext commands. Rejected: (a) pretext→guise → killed: pretext commands. Read aloud: ESS-ence WHOL-ly-TAK-en … COM-mand.

lines: Essence wholly taken — in me, alone, the world's rest,
in knowing's single mass. By skull-staff-bone pretext — command.
l4.sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣahṛtasārā mayy eva jagatsthitiś cidekaghane iti khaṭvāṅgakaraṅkodvahanacchalato dadāsy ājñām
